Loss report: gitlab -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.tag: tag twin of each job (a job cannot wait on a branch push and on a tag, because a tag resource has no version on a push; each job has a twin named <job>-tag that follows the tag resource, and the twin of a needed job feeds the twin that needs it)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/integration ext.passthrough: inline child jobs (the child pipeline ci/child.yml runs inline as jobs integration-check-api, integration-check-ui, integration-seed; the trigger variables are variables of each child job; a return to GitLab restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/integration-check-api job.env: copied into the params of every task (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/integration-check-api job.if: shell guard on each script task; no triggering get (every script task of the job starts with the guard of the condition; the condition is false on every run that starts this job, so the job has no triggering get; the other job of the pair runs the source condition)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/integration-check-api/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/integration-check-api/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
